title: The Ultimate Screen Annotation Tool for Mac in 2026
description: Discover the best screen annotation tool for Mac. Draw, highlight, and present on macOS effortlessly with Markury, fully optimized for Apple Silicon.
author: Markury Team

body.raw:
Finding a high-quality **screen annotation tool for Mac** can be surprisingly frustrating. Many tools are either too basic, outdated, or simply not built for modern macOS environments. If you regularly present on Zoom, teach online, or record screen tutorials, you need a tool that feels native to your Mac.

Enter **Markury**, the modern screen annotation software built from the ground up to provide a seamless, high-performance experience on macOS.

## The Problem with Traditional Mac Annotation Tools

For years, Mac users have had to settle for subpar drawing tools. Many cross-platform tools run via emulation (like Rosetta 2) which drains battery life and causes input lag when drawing. Others clutter your screen with massive toolbars that get in the way of your actual work.

## Why Markury is the Best Annotation Tool for Mac

Markury solves these problems by focusing on three core pillars: **Performance, Aesthetics, and Usability**.

### 1. Optimized for Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3)
Markury runs natively on Apple Silicon. This means zero lag when freehand drawing, instant app startup times, and minimal battery consumption—even when running alongside demanding applications like Zoom, Figma, or Final Cut Pro.

### 2. A Toolbar That Feels Like macOS
The Markury floating toolbar respects Apple’s Human Interface Guidelines. It features beautiful translucent backgrounds, smooth animations, and automatic light/dark mode switching based on your Mac’s system settings.

### 3. Powerful Mac-Specific Shortcuts
Control Markury without ever moving your mouse. You can customize global keyboard shortcuts (like `⌘ + Shift + D`) to instantly toggle drawing mode on and off, switch colors, or activate the laser pointer.

## Essential Features for Mac Professionals

Whether you are a developer reviewing code, a designer giving feedback, or a teacher explaining complex topics, Markury has the tools you need:

- **Freehand Pen & Highlighter:** Smooth, anti-aliased strokes that look natural.
- **Custom Colors:** Go beyond the basics with a 32-color palette and a dynamic color picker to match any presentation.
- **Laser Pointer:** A temporary glowing trail that guides your audience's eyes and fades away automatically.
- **Shape Tools:** Draw perfect rectangles, circles, lines, and arrows to highlight specific areas of your screen.
- **Text Tool:** Type notes directly onto your screen using your favorite Mac fonts.
- **Whiteboard Mode:** Instantly transform your screen into a blank canvas (with 4 different background colors) when you need to brainstorm.

## How to Try Markury on Your Mac

Ready to upgrade your presentations and tutorials? 

1. Download Markury for macOS.
2. Drag the app into your `Applications` folder.
3. Launch Markury and start drawing over any window immediately.
